aiExplanation.summary: This provider coordinates the CZaza Notes webview, editor state, and user actions.
aiExplanation.detail:
- runNotesGeneration, runSectionNoteGeneration, and runLineNoteGeneration: Capture the selected Store when generation starts and pass it through every AI task.
- resolveCurrentNoteStoreLocation: Resolves the exact Team or Personal Store for the current resource.
- blockPersonalTeamOnlyAction: Continues to restrict Runtime Status updates while allowing Personal AI generation.
